jobs.title: Product Cybersecurity Expert
jobs.description:
As a Product Cybersecurity Expert , you will play a key role in ensuring cybersecurity is embedded into the development of Sonova's connected hearing solutions—from embedded software and mobile applications to cloud-based services.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, architects, quality, and regulatory experts, you'll help integrate security into every stage of the product development lifecycle. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

Essential

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, product development, Secure SDLC, or a comparable software development environment.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product cybersecurity or application security.

• Strong understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and how cybersecurity integrates into modern software development.

• Experience working closely with software development teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Experience with DevSecOps and security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and regulations such as IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA or similar frameworks.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or equivalent.

• Experience with cloud security, cryptography, authentication technologies, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principles, AI agent security, and AI-supported development environments.

More about what we offer

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

Joining Sonova means working with highly skilled international teams developing technologies that genuinely improve people's quality of life. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, extensive learning and development opportunities, and clear career paths that support both your professional and personal growth.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to shape secure, connected healthcare technologies while working in an environment where your ideas are valued and your impact is visible.

In qualità di Product Cybersecurity Expert , si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire la sicurezza informatica è incorporato nello sviluppo delle soluzioni uditive connesse di Sonova, dal software integrato e applicazioni mobili ai servizi basati su cloud.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri del software, i team di prodotti, gli architetti, la qualità e gli esperti di regolamentazione, vi aiuterà a integrare la sicurezza in ogni fase del ciclo di vita di sviluppo del prodotto. Invece di concentrarti sulla sicurezza operativa, potrai consentire ai team di ingegneria di costruire prodotti sicuri per design, bilanciando l'innovazione, l'usabilità, la conformità e la fiducia dei clienti.

Se hai un forte background di ingegneria del software e hai ampliato la tua esperienza nella sicurezza informatica del prodotto, questa è un'opportunità per modellare le tecnologie che migliorano la vita di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Integra la sicurezza informatica in tutto il Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) per dispositivi medici collegati, software incorporato, applicazioni mobili e servizi cloud.

• Guidare le attività di modellazione delle minacce, le valutazioni dei rischi di sicurezza informatica e la pianificazione della mitigazione insieme ai team R&D globali.

• Partner con i team di ingegneria del software per incorporare la sicurezza in flussi di lavoro di sviluppo, pratiche DevSecOps e pipeline CI/CD.

• Coordinare le attività di gestione della vulnerabilità del prodotto, tra cui la valutazione, la priorità, il monitoraggio della bonifica e il monitoraggio del post-mercato.

• Supporta le sottomissioni normative e i processi di qualità preparando la documentazione e le prove della sicurezza informatica.

• Consigliare i team di ingegneria, gestione dei prodotti, qualità e regolamentazione sulle decisioni pratiche e basate sul rischio sulla sicurezza informatica.

• Promuovere una mentalità di sicurezza-prima dai team di coaching, sostenendo i campioni di sicurezza, e guidando il miglioramento continuo in R&D.

Più di te

Essenziale

• Laurea o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria Software, Ingegneria, o una disciplina tecnica correlata (o esperienza pratica equivalente).

• 5+ anni di esperienza in ingegneria del software, architettura del software, sviluppo del prodotto, SDLC sicuro, o un ambiente di sviluppo software paragonabile.

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza pratica nella sicurezza informatica del prodotto o nella sicurezza delle applicazioni.

• Forte comprensione di Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) e come la sicurezza informatica si integra nello sviluppo software moderno.

• Esperienza di lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo del software durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

• Competenze di comunicazione eccellenti con la capacità di spiegare argomenti di sicurezza complessi sia per gli stakeholder tecnici che non tecnici.

• Competenza professionale in inglese.

Che bello avere

• Esperienza di sviluppo software per dispositivi medici o altre industrie regolamentate.

• Esperienza con DevSecOps e integrazione di sicurezza nelle tubazioni CI/CD.

• Conoscenza degli standard e delle normative di sicurezza informatica come IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA o framework simili.

• Certificazioni di sicurezza come CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, o equivalente.

• Esperienza con sicurezza cloud, crittografia, tecnologie di autenticazione o sicurezza della supply chain del software.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principi, sicurezza agente AI e ambienti di sviluppo supportati dall'IA.

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l'udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva dove innovazione, collaborazione e apprendimento continuo prosperano.

Unire Sonova significa lavorare con team internazionali altamente qualificati che sviluppano tecnologie che migliorano veramente la qualità della vita delle persone. Offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile, ampie opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo, e percorsi di carriera chiari che supportano sia la crescita professionale che personale.

Qui, avrete l'opportunità di modellare le tecnologie sanitarie sicure e connesse mentre lavorate in un ambiente in cui le vostre idee sono valutate e il vostro impatto è visibile.

jobs.title: Architect Charging Solutions
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape the architecture behind the next generation of charging solutions for hearing devices?

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, covering electronics, embedded software, mechanical interfaces and connectivity across the wider product ecosystem. You will define scalable platform architecture, guide development teams and suppliers, and turn complex requirements into robust, reusable solutions.

More about the role

• Take technical and architectural ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, guiding the development team, setting priorities and supporting effective delivery.

• Design charging architectures spanning electronics and embedded software, while ensuring effective integration with mechanical components.

• Define strategic, reusable platform elements and interfaces between chargers, hearing instruments, production software and application software.

• Translate customer, system and stakeholder needs into solutions that balance functionality, performance, quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

• Review electronic schematics, embedded software architecture and selected code, with hands-on programming representing approximately 10–20% of the role.

• Work closely with external suppliers, review their technical solutions and influence architectural decisions throughout the development chain.

• Make sound technical decisions in complex or uncertain situations and ensure compliance with medical-device, cybersecurity and privacy requirements.

• Document and communicate architectural decisions while promoting technical learning, best practices and continuous improvement across teams.

More about you

Must have

• A Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems or a related technical discipline.

• At least five years of professional experience in hardware and/or embedded software development, including hands-on experience with charging solutions.

• Strong knowledge of electrical hardware and electronic schematics, combined with a solid understanding of embedded software architecture and the ability to review code.

• Experience designing complex hardware–software systems and managing dependencies across electronics, software, mechanics and connected applications.

• A pragmatic and decisive approach, with the ability to navigate uncertainty, evaluate technical trade-offs and drive solutions forward.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical groups and influence internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, together with professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience designing reusable platforms or modular product architectures.

• Experience working in a regulated environment, particularly in the medical-device industry.

• An architecture certification, such as iSAQB, or a PhD in a relevant technical field.

• Experience in technical leadership, agile development or technology assessment.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

As a Power Management Engineer, you will hold a pivotal role in enabling the industry‑leading AI hearing functions that define our next‑generation products. You are the one who ensures that cutting‑edge intelligence is not only possible, but reliably powered every moment. This position sits at the crossroads of multiple technical domains: electronic design, battery innovation, and embedded software, offering a uniquely dynamic environment where your decisions directly shape performance, efficiency, and user experience. It is a role for someone who wants to be at the technological core, driving the energy systems that make advanced hearing AI truly come alive.

.

More about the role

• Design, develop, and optimize battery and power management systems for hearing instruments and charging solutions

• Specify, integrate, and validate power management circuits for rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery systems

• Evaluate, specify, integrate, and optimize Power Management ICs (PMICs) and related power conversion architectures for future hearing instruments and charging systems

• Define and implement battery management algorithms and power strategies, including State of Charge and State of Health estimation, charging behavior, protection mechanisms, and energy optimization

• Collaborate closely with hardware and firmware teams to ensure robust integration of battery and power management functions into the overall hearing instrument and charger architecture

• Develop and validate electrical and system-level models for power consumption, load profiles, and battery behavior under different operating conditions

• Analyze and debug complex power-related system issues, driving root-cause identification and resolution

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of power management platforms, methods, and development processes, and stay informed about emerging technologies and trends

• Evaluate emerging power management technologies and energy management concepts to support future product generations

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field

• Proven experience in the design of power management systems for low-power embedded devices, including DC/DC conversion, load switches, charging circuits, and energy-efficient architectures

• Experience with rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery technologies, as well as a strong understanding of system-level behavior, load profiling, power consumption analysis, and battery aging effects

• Hands-on experience with electrical characterization, laboratory measurements, and data-driven validation of power systems

• Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis, automation, and model development; MATLAB is a plus

• Experience in optimizing ultra-low-power systems under strict energy and size constraints is an asset

• Experience in debugging complex power-related issues in low-power applications and charging systems is an asset

• Structured, proactive, and quality-conscious working style, with the ability to bring forward innovative ideas and collaborate effectively in a distributed, diverse environment

• Fluent in English (spoken and written)

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Employment level 80-100%.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, references, and certificates) via our online job application platform.

For this vacancy only direct applications will be considered.

.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Progettazione, sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei sistemi di gestione della batteria e della potenza per strumenti acustici e soluzioni di ricarica

• Specificare, integrare e convalidare i circuiti di gestione della potenza per i sistemi di batteria ricaricabili e non ricaricabili

• Valutare, specificare, integrare e ottimizzare gli IC di Power Management (PMIC) e le relative architetture di conversione di potenza per futuri strumenti acustici e sistemi di ricarica

• Sviluppare e convalidare modelli elettrici e di livello di sistema per il consumo di energia, profili di carico e comportamento della batteria in diverse condizioni operative

• Analizzare e debug complessi problemi di sistema legati alla potenza, guidando l'identificazione e la risoluzione di root-cause

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme, dei metodi e dei processi di sviluppo di power management e rimanere informato sulle tecnologie e tendenze emergenti

Più di te

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Ingegneria Elettrica/Elettrica, Microelettronica o un campo correlato

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione di sistemi di gestione della potenza per dispositivi incorporati a bassa potenza, tra cui conversione DC/DC, interruttori di carico, circuiti di ricarica e architetture ad alta efficienza energetica

• Esperienza con tecnologie di batteria ricaricabili e non ricaricabili, nonché una forte comprensione del comportamento a livello di sistema, della profilazione del carico, dell'analisi del consumo di energia e degli effetti di invecchiamento della batteria

• Esperienza pratica con caratterizzazione elettrica, misurazioni di laboratorio e validazione dei sistemi di alimentazione

• Forte capacità di programmazione in Python per l'analisi dei dati, l'automazione e lo sviluppo dei modelli; MATLAB è un plus

• L'esperienza nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi ultra-bassi sotto rigidi vincoli di energia e dimensione è un bene

• L'esperienza nel debugging di problemi energetici complessi in applicazioni a bassa potenza e sistemi di ricarica è un bene

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo e di qualità consapevole, con la capacità di portare avanti idee innovative e collaborare efficacemente in un ambiente distribuito e diversificato

• Fluente in inglese (spoken e scritto)

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

Livello di occupazione 80-100%.

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, non vede l'ora di ricevere l'applicazione completa (lettera di copertura, CV, riferimenti e certificati) tramite la nostra piattaforma di applicazione del lavoro online.

• Procurement of goods and services in economic terms and with minimal risk, focusing on technical material and services

• Active participation in product development projects (close exchange with project managers, sparring for all procurement issues)

jobs.description:
Help shape how quality is engineered into products used by millions of people worldwide.

At Sonova, we're looking for an experienced product quality reliability leader to own and evolve our global Critical-to-Quality (CtQ) framework for our Hardware and SW products, ensuring the critical product characteristics are embedded and verified throughout the entire product lifecycle.

Working across Product Development, Manufacturing, Operations, Supplier Quality and Service, you will establish global CtQ governance, drive end-to-end traceability and help shape how innovative hearing solutions are developed over the full product lifecycle.

If you enjoy building frameworks, like reliability engineering activities, train people, working together with other stakeholders and driving continuous improvement in a highly regulated environment, we would love to hear from you.

More about the role

• Own and continuously evolve Sonova's global Critical-to-Quality (CtQ) process, ensuring its implementation and effectiveness across the entire product lifecycle.

• Establish and drive global CtQ governance, standards and best practices across product development, manufacturing, supplier and service.

• Partner with Product Development teams to ensure Critical-to-Quality characteristics and Reliability Engineering principles are considered from the earliest stages of product development.

• Lead cross-functional CtQ reviews, aligning R&D, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality and Service around critical reliability requirements.

• Ensure end-to-end traceability of Critical-to-Quality attributes from product requirements and design through verification, validation, manufacturing and field performance.

• Integrate CtQ requirements into key quality processes, including Design-, Process-, Service FMEA and Safety Risk Management and product development activities.

• Ensure field performance, reliability and customer insights will feed back to CtQs to continuously improve product quality and future product generations.

• Drive continuous improvement of CtQ methodologies, tools and KPIs.

More about you

• A degree in Engineering, Quality, Science or another technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Extensive experience in Product Development, Reliability Engineering, Design Quality, Manufacturing Engineerng or Operational Excellence within a highly regulated industry, ideally Medical Devices, Aerospace or Automotive.

• Hands-on experience leading the practical application of APQP, PPAP, FMEA and Lean initiatives to improve overall product quality.

• Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems with hands-on experience in ISO 9001; experience with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 62304 is an advantage.

• Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, Product Development and Manufacturing teams throughout the product lifecycle is highly desirable.

• A curious, pragmatic and entrepreneurial mindset, combined with excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.

• Fluent English; German is a plus.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans.

jobs.description:
Murten, Switzerland (hybrid)

This role combines software development, automation, and hands-on engineering in an international manufacturing environment. As part of the Manufacturing Engineering team, you will develop equipment, test systems and software used to manufacture and test innovative hearing, communication and consumer products worldwide.

Your responsibilities

•
 Develop manufacturing and test equipment for new products, covering hardware, software and system integration

•
 Create test and configuration sequences using LabVIEW

•
 Develop software interfaces for measurement equipment

•
 Integrate electronic, mechanical and software components into complete manufacturing systems

•
 Validate and qualify equipment before installation at production sites

•
 Maintain and modernize existing manufacturing equipment

•
 Provide second-level support to global production teams, both remotely and occasionally on site

Your profile

•
 At least bachelor’s degree in industrial systems, automation or a related engineering discipline

•
 Around 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, ideally involving electronic devices, embedded software or automated manufacturing systems

•
 Strong LabVIEW programming experience

•
 Knowledge of industrial systems and measurement equipment

•
 Experience with PLC automation

•
 Fluent English, strong communication skills and confidence working with different cultures and stakeholder groups

•
 Structured, solution-oriented approach and the ability to manage unexpected technical challenges

Why join us

You will work on varied engineering projects involving different technologies and product types, from medical devices to consumer products and wireless communication solutions. Your systems will support production centers around the world, giving your work a truly global impact.

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture.
